note: KIS (Khan International Sports, Anantnag) bat line-up for the PlayOrbit Cricket Store launch. Product names, willow types and grades are the manufacturer's; `price` is seeded from public retail listings and is a placeholder for PlayOrbit's own pricing — set it before publishing. Photos: drop the supplier's asset pack into folders named after each sku (e.g. kis-assets/KIS-CLS-KW/01.jpg) and pass --images kis-assets; the first file becomes the card thumbnail. Nothing here is published until --publish is passed or the row is switched on in Admin -> Cricket Store.

products.name: KIS Legends Edition
products.description: The entry bat in the KIS range: Kashmir willow shaped for leather-ball cricket, ready for a first season of hard practice. Light enough for a young batter stepping up from tennis-ball games.

products.name: KIS Classic — Kashmir Willow
products.description: The all-round club bat. Grade A++ Kashmir willow with a traditional profile and a mid blade sweet spot that suits every format.

products.name: KIS AM Unstoppable
products.description: KIS's signature Unstoppable profile — full-bodied Kashmir willow with a pronounced bow and generous edges for players who back themselves through the line.

products.name: KIS Boom Boom Edition
products.description: Grade A++ Kashmir willow with a low sweet spot and heavy edges, built for hitting through the line in white-ball cricket.

products.name: KIS Game Changer — Kashmir Willow
products.description: Grade A++ Kashmir willow, thick edges and a big spine, pressed for power without losing pickup. The step up from the Classic for a regular league batter.

products.name: KIS Bazuka Edition
products.description: The thick-edge Bazuka profile in Kashmir willow — a big, square-shouldered blade for batters who want maximum mass behind the ball.

products.name: KIS M&H 7000
products.description: Grade A++ Kashmir willow from KIS's premium press, hand-finished and knocked in ready. A serious club bat at a Kashmir-willow price.

products.name: KIS Master Pro
products.description: Top-grade Kashmir willow, hand-picked cleft and a players' profile. The best bat KIS make before the English willow range starts.

products.name: KIS Game Changer — English Willow
products.description: Grade A++ English willow, pressed in Kashmir. Straight grains, light pickup for its mass, and the ping a leather-ball season asks for.

products.name: KIS Classic — English Willow
products.description: The English willow Classic: Grade A++ cleft, traditional profile, hand-made and knocked in. KIS's flagship for players in serious competitive cricket.
